description: ONDEWO Speech to Text (S2T) Client library for Typescript

scripts.pretest: rm -rf .test-build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && cp -R api .test-build/api && npm run build:test:protos
scripts.test: c8 node --test .test-build/*/*.spec.js && npm run test:protos && npm run test:release
scripts.test:release: tsc tests/releaseNotes.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build && node --test .test-build/releaseNotes.spec.js
scripts.test:drift: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'),c=require('./.ci-package.json'),d=[];for(const s of ['scripts','devDependencies','dependencies'])for(const k of Object.keys(c[s]||{}))if((p[s]||{})[k]!==c[s][k])d.push(s+'.'+k+' -> package.json: '+JSON.stringify((p[s]||{})[k])+' | .ci-package.json: '+JSON.stringify(c[s][k]));if(d.length){console.error('DRIFT: package.json and .ci-package.json disagree on '+d.length+' key(s):');for(const m of d)console.error('  '+m);process.exit(1)}console.log('OK: package.json matches .ci-package.json on every script and devDependency it declares')"
scripts.build:test:protos: tsc tests/bundleStringRoundTrip.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build
